authority: Synchronized with SYS_10_SCRIPT_STATE_MACHINE.json v1.3. If Knowledge/05_Hook_Blueprints.md disagrees with this file, this file is authoritative.
principle: Optimize retention within medical accuracy. Where retention conflicts with safety or evidence boundaries, safety and evidence take priority. Withhold depth, never the core answer to the thumbnail promise.

beat_notes.beat_3: Answer the thumbnail promise and give one usable piece of value (e.g., name the moves or give one cue). Required within the first 30 seconds per SYS_10 I13.
beat_notes.beat_5: Optional. Credibility may appear here or later in the body as an embedded beat. Any statistic must be approved in the fact-check log.

opening_strategies_ranked.name: physical_participation
opening_strategies_ranked.example: Hold up your hand and look right now
opening_strategies_ranked.condition: Only when the action is safe for the audience and within approved cautions.

opening_strategies_ranked.name: symptom_checklist
opening_strategies_ranked.example: If you have even one of these four signs

opening_strategies_ranked.name: sensory_scenario
opening_strategies_ranked.example: You squint at the menu and everything goes fuzzy

opening_strategies_ranked.name: narrative_cold_open
opening_strategies_ranked.example: Picture this: a 71-year-old man, still mowing his lawn
opening_strategies_ranked.condition: Label as hypothetical; no fictional medical outcomes.

opening_strategies_ranked.name: contrarian_belief_attack
opening_strategies_ranked.example: If you think walking is the best exercise, listen closely
opening_strategies_ranked.condition: The correction must be supported by approved evidence.

opening_strategies_note: O2 (anti_authority_secret) was removed in v1.1. IDs and ranks are preserved; the gap at rank 2 is intentional.

hook_rules.note: Replaces exactly_one_hard_statistic. A statistic is optional; an unapproved statistic is never allowed.
Never frame clinicians or medical care as the villain.
Replaces end_on_open_loop. Give a reason to keep watching without withholding the thumbnail answer.
